The following events occurred in '''3983 BBY'''.

==Events==
*Around this time, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Krynda Draay]] formed the [[Jedi Covenant]], as a result of a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] which foresaw a group that could prevent the return of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Homecoming">In [[Knights of the Old Republic 9|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 9]] [[Krynda Draay]] states that, starting at [[3993 BBY]], she spent the next ten years collecting students until eventually she formed the [[Jedi Covenant]].</ref>
